mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.store_id, o.merchant_id, s.name as store_name, o.status as status_code, CASE WHEN o.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' THEN '待支付' WHEN o.status = 'PAID' THEN '已支付' WHEN o.status = 'PENDING_VERIFICATION' THEN '待核销' WHEN o.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' WHEN o.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' WHEN o.status = 'REFUNDING' THEN '退款中' WHEN o.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN '已退款' ELSE '未知状态' END as status_description, o.remark, o.total_product_price, o.total_discount_amount, o.final_paid_price, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_address_snapshots oas WHERE oas.order_id = o.id AND oas.detail_address IS NOT NULL AND oas.detail_address != '' AND oas.is_deleted = 0) > 0 THEN 'LOCAL_DELIVERY' ELSE 'IN_STORE' END as fulfillment_mode, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_address_snapshots oas WHERE oas.order_id = o.id AND oas.detail_address IS NOT NULL AND oas.detail_address != '' AND oas.is_deleted = 0) > 0 THEN '本地配送' ELSE '到店核销' END as fulfillment_mode_description, CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'WECHAT_PAY' THEN 1 WHEN o.payment_method = 'ALIPAY' THEN 2 WHEN o.payment_method = 'BANK_CARD' THEN 3 END as pay_method, CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'WECHAT_PAY' THEN '微信支付' WHEN o.payment_method = 'ALIPAY' THEN '支付宝' WHEN o.payment_method = 'BANK_CARD' THEN '银行卡' ELSE '其他' END as payment_method_description, o.payment_time, o.verification_code, o.completion_time, o.created_time, o.updated_time FROM orders o LEFT JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.id WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND o.is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, store_id, status, remark, total_product_price, total_discount_amount, final_paid_price, payment_method, payment_time, completion_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, expire_time, verification_code, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time, is_deleted, deleted_time FROM orders WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT o.store_id AS storeId, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, s.name AS storeName, COUNT(*) AS totalOrderCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('PAID', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'COMPLETED') THEN 1 END) AS paidOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_product_price), 0) AS totalSalesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(o.final_paid_price), 0) AS realPayAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('REFUNDING', 'REFUNDED', 'CANCELLED') THEN 1 END) AS refundOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN o.final_paid_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refundAmount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.id WHERE DATE(o.created_time) = #{statDate} AND o.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY o.store_id, o.merchant_id, s.name

SELECT oi.product_sku_id AS productSkuId, oi.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName, oi.sku_name AS skuName, o.store_id AS storeId, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, SUM(oi.quantity) AS salesQuantity, SUM(oi.final_price) AS salesAmount FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE DATE(o.created_time) = #{statDate} AND o.status IN ('PAID', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'COMPLETED') AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND oi.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY oi.product_sku_id, oi.product_id, oi.product_name, oi.sku_name, o.store_id, o.merchant_id ORDER BY salesAmount DESC

SELECT p.category_id AS categoryId, pc.name AS categoryName, o.store_id AS storeId, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, SUM(oi.quantity) AS salesQuantity, SUM(oi.final_price) AS salesAmount FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_categories pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE DATE(o.created_time) = #{statDate} AND o.status IN ('PAID', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'COMPLETED') AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND oi.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.category_id, pc.name, o.store_id, o.merchant_id

SELECT o.merchant_id AS merchantId, o.store_id AS storeId, HOUR(o.created_time) AS hourOfDay, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(o.final_paid_price) AS salesAmount, AVG(o.final_paid_price) AS avgOrderValue FROM orders o WHERE DATE(o.created_time) = #{statDate} AND o.status IN ('PAID', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'COMPLETED') AND o.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY o.merchant_id, o.store_id, HOUR(o.created_time) ORDER BY o.store_id, hourOfDay

SELECT o.merchant_id AS merchantId, o.store_id AS storeId, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.user_id = o.user_id AND o2.created_time < o.created_time AND o2.is_deleted = 0 AND o2.status IN ('PAID', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'COMPLETED') ) THEN o.user_id END) AS newUserCount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS activeUserCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.final_paid_price <= 50 THEN o.user_id END) AS amount0To50, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.final_paid_price > 50 AND o.final_paid_price <= 100 THEN o.user_id END) AS amount50To100, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.final_paid_price > 100 AND o.final_paid_price <= 200 THEN o.user_id END) AS amount100To200, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.final_paid_price > 200 THEN o.user_id END) AS amount200Plus FROM orders o WHERE DATE(o.created_time) = #{statDate} AND o.status IN ('PAID', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'COMPLETED') AND o.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY o.merchant_id, o.store_id
